title: cn: a drop-in replacement for clsx plus tailwind-merge with zero dependencies

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Tailwind class conflicts usually mean combining CLSX with Tailwind merged. CN replaces both through the same familiar APIs, so existing projects can migrate without rewriting every component. It has zero dependencies, works across frameworks and runtimes, and supports custom Tailwind configurations. The maintainers report a 30 time speed up for common component calls backed by reproducible benchmarks.
